header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: None present on behalf of the petitioners nor any intimation is received. This petition was filed in the year 2022. Since then, no efforts were made by the counsel for the petitioners to get the matter fixed to proceed with it. It appears that counsel for the petitioners has lost interest in the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
